import subprocess,time
for sel in ['BLOCKING','ATTACK']:
    t=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run(['/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python','/tmp/r31rev/inh.py','c45',sel],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=280,cwd='/tmp/r31rev')
    print('#####',sel,round(time.time()-t),r.returncode); print(r.stdout[-1500:]); print(r.stderr[-800:])
